infobox.usage: Unlocks an office on the first floor of the financial institution on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Financial institution small office key (Finance s) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to a small office room at the city's financial institution.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Office on the first floor of the financial institution building at Streets of Tarkov.
